description_en: Queries the asynchronous execution result of a source workflow read operation by submit credential. This is a Skill internal operation
description_zh: Skill 内部接口，按提交凭据查询源端工作流读取的异步执行结果
name: GetInnerReadAsyncResult

parameters.help_en: The data source name. The probe task uses this field as its dimension identifier
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称。探查任务以该字段为维度标识
parameters.name: data_source_name

data.description_en: The business data returned by the operation in string format. The content varies depending on the operation
data.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据（字符串形式），具体内容随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. This value is an empty string if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. This value is an empty string if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Use this value to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Use errCode and errMessage to troubleshoot the issue
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
